title: Boss: The Laggy Coin Run
story: The coin counter in your game gives the player too many coins. Walking over the same coin twice must not pay twice.
goal: Fix coins_collected(path, coins) so each coin is counted once, even if the path visits it again.
hints: Where does a coin get counted more than once?
Count each position only once. A set forgets duplicates.
socratic: Which line decides how often a coin counts?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what was the bug, and how did you fix it?
alt:
def coins_collected(path, coins):
    return len(set(path) & set(coins))
